game.name: Shaun White Skateboarding (UK)
game.desc: Shaun White is a sports game on Xbox 360. Skateboarding is celebrated in this title where the most famous redhead on the planet slips away from the snow of the snowparks for activities on wheels. Transform the face of the city as you progress in the world of skateboarding to be able to enjoy the 80 tricks offered by the title.
